statement: For any canonical ordinary CNF state with at most six clauses, exact ordinary elimination of the v0.5 minimum-incidence pivot produces at most six canonical clauses. Thus m<=6 is invariant under continuing ordinary elimination with this selector, and RAW_UNITS<=1+6n for a step beginning with n live variables.
proof: Let m<=6 and selected pivot incidence d=p+q. Raw distinct clause count is at most m-d+p*q before tautology removal and canonicalization.

If d=6, minimum incidence 6 forces m=6 and every live variable to occur in all six clauses. All clauses are full-width sign vectors. A cross-polarity resolvent is non-tautological only for identical nonpivot tails, so there are at most min(p,q)<=3 distinct resolvents and no retained clauses.
If d=5 and m=5, the already-proved m<=5 full-width case applies.

It remains d=5,m=6. There is exactly one retained clause and five pivot clauses. Since d is minimum, every live variable has degree at least 5 and is therefore omitted from at most one of the six clauses.
If p*q<=5, at most five resolvents plus the one retained clause gives at most six raw clauses.
The only numeric danger is polarity split {2,3}, where p*q=6. If any cross pair is tautological, at most five non-tautological resolvents remain and the bound is six.

If all six cross pairs are non-tautological, every nonpivot variable occurs in at least four of the five pivot clauses, hence in at least one clause of each pivot polarity. Complete cross-compatibility forces a single consistent sign for that variable across every pivot clause in which it occurs.

Because each variable is omitted from at most one pivot clause, each positive-negative parent pair jointly covers every nonpivot variable. Therefore all six non-tautological resolvents are the same full-width signed tail and deduplicate to one clause. Together with the retained clause this gives at most two raw distinct clauses.
Thus every d case produces at most six clauses. Induction proves the invariant.
After eliminating one variable from an n-live-variable state, each raw output clause has width at most n-1. Six clauses therefore cost at most 1+6*(1+n-1)=1+6n state units.
